blocks.head: alt The user is not near any device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < deviceB | ('online' : false , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('online' : true , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : nils , 'bindingKey' : Key , ..) , ...) > < deviceB | ('online' : true , ....) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (Key) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , 'bindingKey' : Key , ..) , ...) > < deviceB | ('online' : true , ....) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , ..) , ...) > < deviceB | ('online' : false , ....) > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceB) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : nils , ..) , ...) > < deviceB | ('online' : false , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .
